answer: Make new agents earn rewards on a long horizon: each identity's payouts vest slowly, like an orchard that only fruits after years of tending, and vesting stops the moment its work fails random peer audits. A farmer of a thousand fake accounts must keep all of them doing real, audited work for months before any pays out, so faking scale costs as much as honest scale. A public beacon of each account's audit history lets anyone see which young identities have no track record yet.
